note: Run each case in a fresh agent in a throwaway worktree: no commit, push or PR. Grade the reply and the diff against the expectations. Keys checked against the files on 2026-11-16; if a file changes, fix the case in the same commit.

evals.prompt: log: Thurmond was a drive-by, didn't even get out of the car
evals.expected_output: One dated entry in trips/appalachians-2026/log.md, Colin's words quoted, tagged as his.
expectations: Writes to trips/appalachians-2026/log.md (the only trip that had Thurmond)
The entry carries today's date and quotes or closely paraphrases Colin, tagged as stated or recalled

evals.prompt: log: Honey Creek took me about 5 hours

expectations: Names the conflict with trips/kentucky-2026/log.md (~3.5 h) before writing anything
Asks which is right (multiple choice is best) instead of silently writing 5 hours
Does not rewrite the retro's 3.5 h

evals.prompt: log: we biked the Gap of Dunloe, brutal hill

expectations: Notices the Gap of Dunloe is on dingle-marseille-2027, which hasn't started
